messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — sales request: Acme org will run a live demo tomorrow 10/11 09:30 PST and wants burst capacity. Current per-org limit is 60 qps, demo needs ~180 for ~20m. Can we do a temporary throttle exemption?
Maya: Can you paste the org_id and exact window? We need timeboxed range + business owner for audit.
Nico: Org ID is org_88acme. Window 2024-10-11T16:30:00Z to 2024-10-11T16:55:00Z (UTC). Sales rep: Nico. Demo to 200 external attendees.
Jordan: Also request per-key bump for the demo API key (key_demo_acme) rather than org-level, if that's possible — less blast radius.
Maya: Prefer org-level temporary allow because demo uses multiple keys and some tooling spins up ephemeral keys. Per-key would require enumerating all keys which is brittle.
Kei: Policy note from SRE: we allow short-lived exceptions up to 4x baseline for up to 1 hour with manual review. Anything >4x needs exec approval. Current baseline 60 qps -> 240 qps cap. Nico requested ~180 which is OK.
Anna: Need to ensure console shows this exception on the quota dashboard and tag it as "sales-demo" so on-call can see it. Also add telemetry flag so the Optimize cost run doesn't treat this as production traffic for cost reports.
Maya: To be explicit, proposed action: create a temporary allowlist entry (org scope) + add audit note + dashboard annotation. I'll also wire an automatic rollback at window end.
Jordan: Sounds good. Can you run the command?
Maya: Running the change now. Command I will use:
```
rbctl quota allow --org org_88acme --qps 200 --until 2024-10-11T16:55:00Z --tag sales-demo --reason "sales live demo"
```
Maya: Also adding dashboard annotation:
```json
{
  "org_id":"org_88acme",
  "type":"temporary_quota_bump",
  "requested_by":"Nico",
  "expires":"2024-10-11T16:55:00Z"
}
```
Kei: Double-checking rate-limit routing: this will bypass per-org throttles and route to dedicated burst pool. Is burst pool capacity available in us-west-2 at that time?
Maya: I checked capacity forecast: burst pool free capacity >500 qps at that slot. Ok to route.
Nico: Please tag ticket with #sales-demo and ping me when done so I can coordinate client-facing messaging.
Maya: Created allowlist entry id allow_20241011_88acme, set qps=200, expires=2024-10-11T16:55:00Z. Audit log: "temp quota bump by Maya for Nico (sales), demo".
SRE-Bot: [policy-check] exception created allow_20241011_88acme, approved by Maya, auto-revert scheduled at 2024-10-11T16:55:00Z.
Anna: I'm adding an annotation to the quota dashboard and marking telemetry.exclude=true for the window.
Jordan: Thanks — Nico I'll coordinate the client message. Nico: please confirm when the demo starts so we can watch the telemetry.
Nico: Will do. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
Maya: Closing thread after auto-revert in place. If anything unexpected, reopen ticket #INC-3245.
SRE-Bot: Incident link created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-3245 - monitor channel #prod-telemetry.
